scope: Trusted development-only Sepolia fee faucet helper; no real signing, mint or network action

checks.procedure: Temporary independent mutation probes against helper using original labelled provider fixture and disposable test key; no repository source edits
observed: After successful included/finalized observation then receipt=null, journal observation.gasUsed becomes undefined.
Signer error code getter returns allowed primitive on validation reads and arbitrary test sentinel on third read; returned sanitized message contains sentinel.

findings.scenario: Reconcile known inclusion, then transient missing receipt. Fresh unknown report overwrites prior stored block/gas/token accounting despite no contradiction proving that prior observation false.
findings.repair: Preserve bounded last included/history facts independently of current availability/reorg/finality outcome. Never infer replay or finality from historical observation; preserve one-send fence.

findings.scenario: error.code is read three times; changing accessor can return unvalidated secret third value, or throw raw private error. Regex also admits arbitrary provider-private uppercase suffixes.
findings.repair: Capture code once inside guarded extraction and accept only fixed known codes or privately branded own errors; unknown/accessor failure maps fixed UNAVAILABLE. Add changing/throwing/allowed-prefix-secret regressions.

verified: fileState uses private temp file fsync, rename and parent directory fsync; uncertain write prevents further writes and send intent precedes one literal HTTP broadcast.
Restart with raw prepared bytes or any intent inspects only; dropped/absent/failed broadcast acknowledgments never grant send authority.
Actual ethers signed type2 transaction is checked for exact Sepolia sender/recipient/handler/value/calldata/nonce/gas/fee/access-list scope; no authorization-list delegation transaction introduced.
Read preflight validates exact runtime hashes, mintAmount, token/minter/decimals, nonce and fee/gas balance; send uses direct redirect-disabled single fetch.

Receipt reconciliation rejects chain/receipt/transaction/code/accounting mismatches; exact own mint and aggregate same-block token deltas checked; sender gas-only conservation rejects concurrent unrelated transfers.
mandatory_operator_preconditions: Caller must acquire sender-wide exclusive operational lease across all journals, wallet sessions and tools; helper lock is per journal path only.
Use fresh live Sepolia chain/code/delegation/recipient/fee checks and trusted provider; supplied runtime constants/snapshots are not a current health claim.
Private0700 dedicated directory and0600 journal hold broadcastable signed bytes; preserve it through any uncertainty, never start another attempt due missing receipt.
Caller owns bounded provider lifetime/deadline and supported signer custody. No real privileged use before repaired exact revision review.
limits: Provider/receipt/log tests use labelled doubles; only disposable ethers signing is real.
No purchase, fee mint or credential access performed.
Strict accounting may remain blocked by same-block incoming ETH or other sender traffic; do not waive to report pass.
